Engineering across

My work connects power-stage design with the controls, magnetics and test systems needed to make it perform.

I work with MATLAB/Simulink, circuit simulation, magnetic analysis, PCB design and laboratory tools. Alongside design and validation, I develop reusable tools that make calculations easier to inspect and engineering decisions easier to explain.
